title: Cristaux (1970). Gribouillis et calculs divers : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This page is not Grothendieck's own manuscript. The image is upside down, and it shows the typed verso of a Bourbaki rédaction (draft n° 382, p. 73). It belongs to the Bourbaki treatment of differentiable/analytic varieties and vector bundles, §6.7–6.8. Grothendieck evidently reused Bourbaki drafts as scratch paper; the facing pages carry his handwritten notes on Lubin–Tate groups and Dieudonné/Tate theory.

The typed content is routine multilinear algebra of vector bundles over a base B and a commutative field L:
(1) The bundle F = Hom^L(⊗_{i=1}^n E_i, E) has sections φ that pair with sections s_i of the E_i to give sections ⟨φ, s_1⊗…⊗s_n⟩ = φ(s_1,…,s_n) of E. This pairing is C_L(U)-multilinear, where C_L(U) is the ring of L-valued functions of the relevant class on U.
(2) Conversely, suppose that for every open U one is given a C_L(U)-multilinear map S_{E_1}(U)×…×S_{E_n}(U) → S_E(U), compatible with restrictions. Then this family comes from a unique global section of F. This is the multilinear version of the tensoriality lemma, i.e. sheaf-level Hom = section of the Hom bundle; n° 6.2.3 treats n = 1.
(3) There is an alternating analogue with F' = ∧^n E_1^* ⊗ E = Hom(∧^n E_1, E).
(4) Section 6.8.1 defines the tensor bundles T^I_J(E) = ⊗_{α∈I∪J} E_α, with E_α = E for α ∈ I and E^* for α ∈ J. Fibres are the algebraic tensor spaces T^I_J(E_b) of Bourbaki Algèbre III. One writes T^p_q(E) = (⊗^p E)⊗(⊗^q E^*), and a total order on I and J gives a canonical isomorphism T^I_J(E) ≅ T^p_q(E).
errors: No mathematical errors. The identification ∧^n E^* ⊗ E ≅ Hom(∧^n E, E) uses the canonical duality (∧^n E)^* ≅ ∧^n(E^*) for finite-rank bundles, which is standard. The draft leaves the Algèbre references blank ('§   , n°   ').

ideas.what: Sections of Hom(⊗E_i, E) correspond to function-ring-multilinear, restriction-compatible maps on local sections
ideas.modern_name: Tensoriality lemma / sheaf Hom of locally free sheaves equals sections of the Hom bundle
ideas.where_published: Bourbaki, Variétés différentielles et analytiques, Fascicule de résultats (§6–7), in the published form of this draft

ideas.what: Tensor bundles T^I_J(E) indexed by finite disjoint sets, with reordering isomorphisms

deep.surprise_reason: This is a typed Bourbaki draft page on elementary vector-bundle multilinear algebra, reused as scratch paper. It is not original Grothendieck mathematics and contains nothing unrecorded.
transcription_corrections: The page image is rotated 180°. It is a typed Bourbaki draft (n° 382, p. 73), not a handwritten note.
'alors ⊗ s_i est une section ⊗ E_i' should read 'est une section de ⊗_{i=1}^{n} E_i' (the 'de' is likely present in the original).
The handwritten mark '50' in the corner is the archive folio number.
